1    INT. BAR - NIGHT                                              1

     A small crowd. MARA (30s) and JONAH (40s) at opposite ends
     of the counter.

             MARA                            JONAH (V.O.)
     You said you would not come.        (over the music)
                                     I said a lot of things, and
                                     none of them were true, and
                                     you know it as well as I do.

                          - A LONG MINUTE -

2    EXT. STREET - CONTINUOUS                                      2

     Rain on the awning, number 1, and a neon sign that flickers
